exchanges: back at it. another week as a millwright apprentice and my arms hate me
It's physical work, your arms will toughen up soon.
the folks at tarrant have us on nights now which wrecks my sleep
Night shifts take some adjusting, be kind to yourself.
i carpool in with a couple guys from my street, they argue about football the whole way
At least the ride is never boring!
my girlfriend elowen made soup for when i got home, love her
That's such a kind thing to come home to.
my brother kit came by to borrow tools again
Sounds like you're the family hardware store.
his datsun is held together with tape at this point
Ha, sounds like a car with a lot of stories.
weather is grim
Grim weather calls for something warm to drink.
came down with shingles of all things, doc said its stress
That sounds really painful, I hope you can get some rest.
so im off work for a bit, kinda bored
Maybe a good excuse to rest properly for once.
my brother in law fergal offered to drive me to appointments in his lancia, very fancy
That's generous of him, and a stylish ride too.
the tortoise escaped into the hedge again, mum was frantic
Escape artists, all of them!
my mum reckons admiral is older than her and he still has more energy than me
Slow and steady really does win the race.
had wilco on all morning, still my fave band
Good music makes a sick day a lot better.
my friend dov is moving to brackenfold, gutted
That's hard, it's tough when a friend moves away.
he says its for a quieter life but i reckon its for a girl
Could be a bit of both!
dov also bought a canoe so hes clearly having a midlife thing
Ha, there are worse midlife purchases!
napped half the afternoon
Your body probably needed it.
craving dumplings from kalinka so bad, best place in town
Nothing beats a craving for a favourite spot.
my girlfriend says shell pick some up after her shift
She sounds like a keeper.
feeling a bit better today actualy
Glad to hear it, small steps.
kit said hes coming round with a film tonight
A film night sounds like a good distraction.
the lads i ride in with sent me a get well card, soft
That's really thoughtful of them.
fergal's dragging me to curling once im better, apparently hes obsessed
That could be a fun new thing to try!
anyway, nap time again
Enjoy the rest!

questions.message: remind me whats my trade called
